note: Generated from passages retrieved from the design document, then checked against those same passages by the lore critic. Corrections and the drafts they replaced are in critique/critique_log.json.

torn_foil_blanket.flavour: A six-sided grey slab with fracture lines crawling right across its face and a notch bitten out of the top edge. Lightest thing in the whole field, and it still wants to come apart in the tether.

crumpled_panel_stack.flavour: Quilted beige sheeting over white, rust and blue under-layers, with a ragged burn hole punched clean through the top face. Cheap floor scrap, sold by the armful.

cracked_solar_array.flavour: Two angular gridded blue fragments, tilted apart where one panel let go. The pale edges are glass-sharp and the grid will keep on splitting if you jostle it.

bent_truss_section.flavour: A dozen thin rusty bars crossed at every angle in a flat mat, speckled brown where the coating gave up. Scraped off the floor of the envelope, and it pays like the floor.

spent_kick_motor_casing.flavour: An hourglass of grey metal, flared at both ends with a sooty throat pinched in the middle. Compact, solid, and heavier in the hand than it looks from the cockpit.

collapsed_dish_frame.flavour: A shallow grey dish still bolted to its stump of a base, feed arm reaching over the centre, rim dented and split down one side. Bulky enough to fight you all the way to the hold.

shredded_antenna_mesh.flavour: One long shaft carrying ten short crossbars, half of them kinked or broken off short, with a blue-grey lump fused near the low end. The rest snap if you swing it.

cracked_battery_pallet.flavour: A dark slab of a unit wrapped in a fat yellow crash frame, tipped on its side, one small inset port winking pale at the corner. Whole, and it survived whatever put it here.

seized_reaction_wheel_housing.flavour: Eight spokes from a stubby hub out to a wide flat rim, one notch chewed out of the low edge. It does not turn any more and it does not care that you tried.

burst_pressurant_sphere.flavour: Three or four black angular chunks jammed together, faces pitted, chipped edges going pale where something struck them. No seams, no fittings, nothing manufactured left in it.

delaminated_radiator_fin.flavour: A stepped grey plate with six bolt holes near the corners and two scratches scored across the middle. Thin enough that a rough grab is what finally folds it.

torn_solar_wing_spar.flavour: Two tall wings side by side, ruled into dark blue cells with pale dividers, the right one sitting a few degrees out of true with its neighbour. Flat, awkward, and it catches on everything.

cracked_optics_barrel.flavour: A short ribbed cylinder on its side, front element dark and holding one bright cyan glint, with a spare ring section parked behind it. That glint goes the first time you knock it.

fractured_docking_collar.flavour: A heavy hollow ring, thicker on one side, with a bite broken out of the upper rim and three specks of itself still drifting alongside. Whatever it held on to, it let go.

dead_thruster_quad.flavour: A corrugated drum of pale ridged discs bolted to a tan block, with one brown feed line looping over the top and back down. Dry as a bone since the cascade.

buckled_pressure_bulkhead.flavour: A ragged-edged grey plate with a deep crease folded through it, shedding chips off one side as it turns. Oversized, unwieldy, and it costs you most of a trip on its own.

ruptured_helium_tank.flavour: Quilted blue soft goods rolled long and cinched at the waist with tan strapping, ends still puffed out. Intact, which around here counts as a small miracle.

shattered_star_tracker.flavour: A bevelled frame holding pale blue glass, cracks radiating out from a black star-shaped hole punched dead centre. One more knock and you are hauling a frame full of grit.

warped_gyro_deck.flavour: An upright grey cabinet with a blue screen, rows of coloured indicator strips and a vent grid, red and blue cables spilling out the bottom and a yellow rod jutting off the top.

cracked_ablative_nose_cone.flavour: A tapering grey shell with a raised rib running down the spine and a jagged broken edge where the rest of it stayed behind. Already half gone, so handle the half you have.

split_avionics_rack.flavour: One green board, two fat black chips, a red can and a row of gold contact fingers along the bottom edge, with a mounting tab still sticking out the side. Snaps like a biscuit.

torn_reactor_shield_plate.flavour: A jagged green shard with two yellow stripes and a couple of components clinging on, one splinter drifting free and a rust-brown wire curling underneath. Top-shelf scrap, and it pays like it.

cracked_deep_space_dish.flavour: A grey dish on a blocky mount, feed arm on struts crossing its face, rim gone irregular where something folded it. Thin skin, high price, and it dents if you look at it wrong.

fused_ion_grid_assembly.flavour: A square navy frame with nothing left inside it but pale cyan shards angling in from the corners and a hollow middle. What is left is edges, so tether it gently.

severed_boom_mast.flavour: A braided strand running long and twisted, frayed open into a bristly knot where it was cut. Bulky in the hold, and this high up every kilo of it pays.

scorched_fuel_cell_stack.flavour: A grey open case partitioned into compartments of blocky cells, yellow, red and orange bars still marking charge on each one. Dense, tidy, and worth the climb.

shattered_cryo_dewar.flavour: A bright cyan tank on its side, stub fittings at both ends, one nozzle up top and H2O stencilled black across the belly. Somebody's drinking water, worth a fortune this high up — and a shell thin enough to split on a rough haul.

impact_pitted_engine_bell.flavour: A flared cone standing on ring ridges, throat black with soot and the base rim crusted rust-brown. Dense enough that the tether goes taut before you have finished pulling.

cracked_command_module_hatch.flavour: One small hex ring, face-on, hole through the middle, a highlight on the upper corner and nothing else in the cell. It will not take a knock, and it is absurd that a nut from up here outsells a panel from down low.

armstrongs_module.flavour: A grey canister lying diagonal, rimmed at both ends, two yellow bands around its body, one end dented and a chip broken off beside it. Apollo-era, older than the cascade, and heavier on its own than everything else in the field put together.
